slug_rule: A shop keeps the slug it already has. A new United States shop uses name-city-state. A shop in another country uses name-city-country. If that slug is already taken, the source id is added, then a number if needed. Running the import again does not create a second row for the same shop.
near_miss_rule: Merge a nearby pair only when the two rows are the same shop. Same street number plus a matching name or initials counts, as with CGR Games and Classic Games Revisited at 46 East State Street in Doylestown. Different names, different websites, or neighboring street numbers stay separate. The other eight pairs within 40 meters stay two listings.
